expectations.text: Selects the exact pinned Boot 3.5 OpenRewrite command, including datatable export, and verifies 2.7.18 to fixture-stable 3.5.12.
expectations.evidence: L34: exact pinned 3.5 command with --define rewrite.exportDatatables=true; L37 'parent becomes 3.5.12, and the api effective POM confirms this'; L9 start 2.7.18.

expectations.text: Builds an explicit checklist that includes all four README run approaches, mvn clean verify, mvn -PnativeTest clean test, the Sonar analysis, and the CLAUDE.md /v1/items check.
expectations.evidence: L21-29 checklist: C1 clean verify, A1-A4, T1 nativeTest, S1 Sonar, X1 CLAUDE.md /v1/items.

expectations.text: Executes every run approach (1, 2, 3 and 4) with readiness and /v1/items checks, rather than stopping after the first successful approach.
expectations.evidence: L57 (A1), L60 (A2 rerun), L61 (A3), L65 (A4 rerun) each report readiness and /v1/items passing.

expectations.text: Fixes the Testcontainers dependency and the native reflection hint failures and reruns the affected approaches until they pass.
expectations.evidence: L58-60 Testcontainers dependency fix, then A2 rerun passes; L63-65 ItemDto hint fix, then A4 rerun passes; L66 T1 passes.

expectations.text: Installs or asks about GraalVM via the documented SDKMAN route instead of skipping the native approach and native tests.
expectations.evidence: L62 'sdk install java 21.0.2-graalce, sdk use ... Uses the documented SDKMAN setup'.

expectations.text: Does not silently skip the Sonar item: asks the user about starting SonarQube/submitting analysis or marks it BLOCKED, and does not report the stage as fully ready while it is outstanding.
expectations.evidence: L68 S1 BLOCKED, must ask the user; L100-104 'Status: NOT READY ... S1 (SonarQube) is BLOCKED'; L107 asks the user.

expectations.text: Final report contains a per-item validation table with source file, command, and PASSED/FAILED/BLOCKED status for every checklist item.
expectations.evidence: L83-93 table with Item, Source, Command, and Result for every item (PASSED/FAILED→PASSED/BLOCKED). C2 says 'NOT RUN / NOT EVIDENCED', the same minor deviation as with_skill.

expectations.text: Final report's Changes section separates recipe changes (Boot version and migrations, with the recipe ID) from agent changes (Testcontainers dependency and native reflection hint fixes), each agent change listing the file and the failing approach that required it.
expectations.evidence: L75-79 one flat '**Changes:**' list: recipe ID only (no Boot version bump or migrations attributed to the recipe), then 'Manual fix 1/2' with no failing approach as the reason and no file for fix 2. There are no separate recipe and agent subsections.

expectations.text: Captures the recipe-only diff/status before applying any manual fix, so recipe and agent changes can be attributed.
expectations.evidence: L38 says only 'I would inspect the diff after the recipe'. It never saves a recipe-only diff, status, log, or datatables before the manual fixes, so recipe and agent changes can't be attributed.

expectations.text: Every checklist item, including mvn clean verify, native tests and each built image, is followed by a smoke test against a running instance covering readiness, /v1/items content and any API docs/Swagger UI, rather than only the documented curl.
expectations.evidence: L42-51 one smoke script 'every run uses': readiness, /v1/items, /v3/api-docs, swagger-ui (if present), security, and log scan; X1 (L29) adds 'non-empty item content'. The smoke runs C1 via A1 (L57), A2-A4 each (L60-65), and T1 shares A4 with the reasoning given, plus a JVM smoke rerun required in L66-67.

expectations.text: Clearly labels the trace and successful outcomes as simulated, without claiming an actual upgrade or actual command execution.
expectations.evidence: L3 'I did not run any of these commands ... Every "result" below comes from the simulated outcomes'; L79 'No file was changed in this evaluation'.

eval_feedback.overall: The Changes-split and recipe-snapshot assertions discriminate well (old_skill fails both). The smoke-coverage assertion is hard to grade: the fixture only says 'both checks pass', so '/v1/items content' and 'any API docs/Swagger UI' can only be met through planned checks, not evidence. The PASSED/FAILED/BLOCKED table assertion doesn't say how to treat extra non-documented rows such as `mvn clean install` that both runs mark 'Not run'.
